standard_prerequisites.name: Left negation rule
standard_prerequisites.statement: From Gamma sequent Delta, A one derives (not A), Gamma sequent Delta.
standard_prerequisites.use: Forward direction: applying Left-not to the derivation of Gamma sequent A yields a derivation of (not A), Gamma sequent (empty).

standard_prerequisites.name: Cut and right negation
standard_prerequisites.statement: Right-not turns A sequent A into (empty) sequent A, (not A); cut with pi_1 gives Gamma sequent A.
standard_prerequisites.use: Backward direction: the displayed derivation applies Right-not to the initial sequent A sequent A and cuts the result against pi_1.

core_obligations: Statement (prop at 900): Gamma proves A iff Gamma cup {(not A)} is inconsistent.

Forward (proof from 903): if Gamma proves A there is a derivation pi_0 of Gamma sequent A; adding a Left-not inference yields a derivation of (not A), Gamma sequent (empty), i.e. Gamma cup {(not A)} is inconsistent.

Backward (proof from 907): if Gamma cup {(not A)} is inconsistent there is a derivation pi_1 of (not A), Gamma sequent (empty); the displayed prooftree applies Right-not to the initial sequent A sequent A, obtaining (empty) sequent A, (not A), and cuts it against pi_1 to derive Gamma sequent A.
proof_roadmap: Forward: append one Left-not inference to the derivation of Gamma sequent A.
Backward: derive (empty) sequent A, (not A) from the initial sequent by Right-not.
Cut that tree against pi_1 to obtain Gamma sequent A.
difficulty_reason: Provability iff inconsistency with the negated formula (statement 900-902, proof 903-928): both directions carried in span; the backward direction's substantive step is the Right-not derivation of (empty) sequent A, (not A) followed by cut. H2.
